name: did-we-drift
description: Project-drift audit for agent-built software: verifies a durable, version-controlled plan/tracking surface exists (root authority, evidence-gated progress, drift definition, audit cadence, dated baseline), then verdicts ON TRACK / DRIFTED (MINOR|MATERIAL|CAPTURED) / BLOCKED / NO BASELINE. Grade-gated drift interrupts with plain-English consequence scenarios, snooze-with-memory, transactional repair, regenerated pointer-only resume prompts, and run-to-plan binding for /loop and /goal sprints. QUICK single-agent audit by default; contamination-scaled DEEP fan-out when triggers fire.
